grain: one row per user observed before each rolling cutoff
assignment_boundary: all behavior features and thresholds use report_date < cutoff_date
evaluation_boundary: future_* fields use the 30-day rolling window only

manual_rules.no_active_history: no historical direct purchase and no historical redemption at any tenure
manual_rules.history_insufficient: fewer than 28 days between first observation and cutoff
manual_rules.observed_never_used: at least 28 days observed, no active flow, and zero historical maximum balance
manual_rules.passive_balance_only: at least 28 days observed, no active flow, but a positive historical balance
manual_rules.funded_never_withdrawn: historical direct purchase, zero historical redemption, positive current balance
manual_rules.dormant_zero_balance: previously active, no active flow in 90 days, zero current balance
manual_rules.low_turnover_holder: positive balance, at most one active-flow day in 90 days, low recent redemption
manual_rules.frequent_large_roundtrip: 90-day frequency >= fold p75, at least three direct-purchase and transfer days, transfer volume >= fold p90, roundtrip ratio >= 0.5
manual_rules.frequent_small_consumer: consumption frequency >= fold p75, median event <= fold event p50, consumption >= 50% of redemption
manual_rules.transfer_oriented: transfer is at least 80% of 90-day redemption
manual_rules.consumption_oriented: consumption is at least 80% of 90-day redemption

automatic_clustering.population: users with at least 28 days of history, active history, and recent active flow or positive current balance
automatic_clustering.preprocessing: log transforms for amounts, robust median/IQR scaling, clip to [-6, 6]
automatic_clustering.selection: lowest combined rank over Calinski-Harabasz, Davies-Bouldin, repeated-start ARI, and minimum cluster share
